description: Terminal Aerodrome Forecast (TAF) for one or more ICAO airport codes (e.g. KSFO,EGLL); returns forecast periods covering wind, visibility, and cloud ceilings for the next 24–30 h.

date.description: Optional. ISO-8601 UTC instant (e.g. "2026-08-20T12:00:00Z") to retrieve the TAF that was valid then. Omit for the current forecast — the TAF already covers the next 24–30 h, so there is no lookback-hours argument.

ids.description: Comma-separated ICAO codes (4 letters, e.g. KSFO,EGLL) — not IATA codes.

name: taf
